title: Unsettled Spirits (Part 2)
flavor: In the legends of the Tauren, it was Leshrac, the mentor of all druids, who first taught the Druid Beliefs to the Tauren tribe. But the one who is more widely known is the first Kal’dorei druid, the prophet Furion. He led the Kal’dorei through the War of the Ancients and the following years, and created the great world tree Nordrassil. The Cenarion Circle that was later established, where all members came from different countries and different races had the same belief in their hearts - for nature and balance, for the Altar of Spirits.

entries.name: Druid - Synergy
entries.detail: (6) Added. (2) Druids: Two identical Druid★ can promote to a Druid★★. (4) Druids: Two identical Druid★★ can promote to a Druid★★★. (6) Druids: Two identical Druid★★★ can promote to the great Altar of Spirits♥♥♥, and gain several(equal to the level of Druid★★★) stack of Altar Power, and destroy all Druid pieces in the chess pool. P.S.: Every stack of Altar Power can reduce 10% damage taken and amplify 20% damage dealt. P.S.: Altar Power can be shared by all ally Druid pieces tethered by Altar of Spirits♥♥♥. Druids can control the great power of Nature to protect spirits and balance.
